A natural weapon of the Apocritara: his natural attack "Mandible Bite", a Cut attack.

Target makes STR Save every 3 seconds or held.

A natural weapon of the Apocritara: his natural attack "Stinger", a Pierce attack.

Only a Apocritara of slight physique has this.
